title: Gut All Cells Human
author: Kylie James
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q3xdypn
materials: Receive samples. Take about 4mm^2 sample for OCT

steps.title: Wash and mince tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the samples twice with HBSS medium, then mince the tissue in a petri dish into approximately 0.5 cm pieces.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples twice with HBSS medium.
Mince sample into ~0.5 cm pieces in a petri dish.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in 2 mL HBSS containing 1.07 Wunsch units · mL⁻¹ (2.14 WU) Liberase DH (Roche Applied Science, Germany) and 70 U mL⁻¹ hyaluronidase (Calbiochem/Merck, Germany) for 45 min at 37 °C on a shaking platform set to 600 rpm, homogenising the suspension every 15 min by pipetting up and down with a 1 mL pipette for 1 min.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 45 min at 37 °C, 600 rpm shaking.
Every 15 min, homogenise by pipetting up/down with a 1 mL pipette for 1 min.

steps.title: Filter and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Pass the digested cells through a 40 mM sieve, then centrifuge at 300 g, 4 °C for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Pass cells through a 40 mM sieve.
Spin down at 300 g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in DNase buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 mL PBS containing 100 IU mL⁻¹ DNase II (Sigma Aldrich, Missouri, USA).

steps.title: Perform bead enrichment
steps.instruction: Enrich cells using bead‑based selection according to the manufacturer’s protocol, typically a Miltenyi CD45⁺ enrichment.

steps.title: Count and dilute cells
steps.instruction: Count the enriched cells and dilute them with PBS to the desired concentration.

steps.title: Load cells onto 10X
steps.instruction: Load the cells onto the 10X Chromium system, aiming for 5,000 cells per run.
